title: Dashboard shows stats, upcoming deadlines, and recent activity
description: Verifies the dashboard overview renders key operational sections including stats, upcoming deadlines, and recent activity.

steps.description: Verify upcoming deadlines and recent activity are displayed

title: Dashboard cards navigate to Clients and return keeps layout intact
description: Verifies a user can navigate from dashboard cards to the clients area and return to the dashboard while keeping the app shell intact.

steps.description: Click a dashboard card that navigates to clients
Verify the clients management page is displayed
Click the app navigation item to go to the dashboard
Verify the user lands on the dashboard and the app shell navigation remains visible

title: Create a revenue entry and see it listed and reflected in cashflow summary
description: Verifies a user can record a revenue entry with required fields and it appears in the ledger with the cashflow summary updated.

steps.description: Click the navigation item to open the financial area
Start creating a new financial entry
Select revenue as the entry type
Fill a valid date into the date field
Verify the new entry is listed in the financial ledger
Verify the cashflow summary reflects the new revenue

title: Rebranded login-to-dashboard entry shows welcome overlay and unified navigation
description: Verifies a user can log in and lands on the dashboard where the welcome overlay and the unified app shell navigation are visible.

steps.description: Verify the user lands on the dashboard
Verify a welcome overlay and the app shell navigation (sidebar/topbar) are visible

title: Create a new process and see it on the Kanban board
description: Verifies a user can create a process with required case details and the new process appears as a card in the Kanban board.

steps.description: Click the navigation item to open the processes area
Fill a valid process number into the process number field
Fill a valid tribunal into the tribunal field
Verify the new process card is displayed on the Kanban board

title: Create a client with CPF/CNPJ and open client detail with linked sections
description: Verifies a paralegal can create a client with required CPF/CNPJ, see it in the list, and open the detail view where linked sections render.

steps.description: Click the app navigation item to go to clients
Fill a unique client name into the name field
Fill a valid CPF or CNPJ into the identifier field
Open the newly created client from the list
Verify the client detail view is displayed with sections for processes, notes, and financial records

title: Move a process card to another status column
description: Verifies a user can move a process card to a different Kanban status and the card is shown in the new column.

steps.description: Click the navigation item to open the processes area
Fill a valid process number into the process number field
Fill a valid tribunal into the tribunal field
Drag the newly created process card to a different status column
Verify the process card is displayed in the destination status column

title: Dashboard financial values visibility can be toggled
description: Verifies a user can toggle financial values visibility and the dashboard reflects values as hidden or shown accordingly.

steps.description: Toggle the control for financial values visibility
Verify financial values on the dashboard are hidden
Toggle the control for financial values visibility again
Verify financial values on the dashboard are shown

title: Client creation is blocked when CPF/CNPJ is missing
description: Verifies attempting to create a client without CPF/CNPJ shows a validation error and does not create a new client record.

steps.description: Click the app navigation item to go to clients
Fill a unique client name into the name field
Leave the CPF/CNPJ identifier field empty
Verify a validation error is visible indicating the identifier is required
Verify no new client is added to the clients list

title: Client detail linked sections remain consistent after navigating away and back
description: Verifies the client detail view linked sections remain visible and consistent after navigating to another area and returning.

steps.description: Click the app navigation item to go to clients
Fill a unique client name into the name field
Fill a valid CPF or CNPJ into the identifier field
Open the newly created client from the list
Click the app navigation item to go to the dashboard
Click the app navigation item to go back to clients
Open the same client from the list
Verify the client detail view still shows sections for processes, notes, and financial records

title: Dashboard blocks can be reordered via drag and drop
description: Verifies the user can reorder dashboard blocks and the new order is reflected visually.

steps.description: Drag one dashboard block and drop it into a different position
Verify the dashboard block order updates to reflect the drop position

title: Prevent saving a financial entry without an amount
description: Verifies that attempting to save a financial entry without an amount shows a validation error and the entry is not added to the ledger.

steps.description: Click the navigation item to open the financial area
Start creating a new financial entry
Fill a valid date into the date field
Attempt to save the financial entry
Verify an amount validation error is visible
Verify no new entry is added to the financial ledger

title: Welcome overlay can be dismissed without breaking dashboard layout
description: Verifies the welcome overlay can be dismissed and the dashboard remains usable with the app shell layout intact.

steps.description: Verify the welcome overlay is no longer visible
Verify dashboard content and the app shell navigation are still visible

title: Glassmorphism metric cards render on dashboard after login
description: Verifies the dashboard loads and displays the rebranded metric cards with the expected card-based layout.

steps.description: Verify metric cards are displayed on the dashboard
Verify the dashboard uses a card-based layout consistent with the app shell

title: Drag a process card to the same status column does not change its column
description: Verifies dragging a process card and dropping it back into the same column does not move it to a different status column.

steps.description: Click the navigation item to open the processes area
Fill a valid process number into the process number field
Fill a valid tribunal into the tribunal field
Drag the new process card within its current status column and drop it back into the same column
Verify the process card remains displayed in its original status column

title: Rapid successive status changes keep only the latest status in view
description: Verifies that moving the same process card across multiple status columns in quick succession results in the card ending in the final column.

steps.description: Click the navigation item to open the processes area
Fill a valid process number into the process number field
Fill a valid tribunal into the tribunal field
Drag the process card to a different status column
Drag the same process card to another status column
Verify the process card is displayed in the final destination status column

title: Accept large amount values with decimals in a financial entry
description: Verifies a user can enter a large decimal amount for a financial entry and it is saved and shown in the ledger.

steps.description: Click the navigation item to open the financial area
Start creating a new financial entry
Select revenue as the entry type
Fill a valid date into the date field
Verify the new entry is listed in the financial ledger
